source:
[u][b]The Demon Ojou-sama Oppai Bunny!♥[/b][/u]
Race: Demon (Nacuras Tribe)
Second Year at Lepus Rabirio Bunny Academy
Evil Tennis Club President

A second-year student at Lepus Rabirio Bunny Academy and a girl of the Demon race. She is very prideful and hates to lose in front of the protagonist. She often acts like a clumsy, boastful rich girl trying to show off. (On the surface she seems self-centered, but at her core, she’s actually kind-hearted.)

She always calls the protagonist "commoner teacher."

She was originally human but was transformed into a demon by a curse, and it seems she was also given the "Destruction" curse. It’s said to be a curse where "falling in love with someone causes one's own destruction," so in order to avoid falling for the protagonist and bringing about her own ruin, she often behaves in ways that are the complete opposite of her true feelings. (Thus, being "lovers" would be bad, but "sex friends" might be OK!?)

She tries to avoid romance to prevent triggering the destruction flag, but her feelings for the protagonist grow stronger with each passing day.

She belongs to the "Evil Tennis Club," which she herself founded.

Her [url=/c149529]mother[/url] is a Bunny Sister filled with compassion and is constantly worried about her daughter, who was turned into a demon by the curse.

As for sexual knowledge, although she understands the related naughty words, she has never actually experienced anything herself, making her shy and inexperienced. (It seems she fantasizes during masturbation.)

Her verbal habit is often to decorate her speech with "Devilishly~" to emphasize her own greatness.

Her hobbies are afternoon herbal tea, tennis, and window shopping.
